spans.s:
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Beloved, dear, desired.
m. (-यः)
1 A husband, a lover.
2 A sort of drug, commonly Ṛddhi.
3 A sort of [] deer.
f. (-या)
1 A woman.
2 A wife or mistress.
3 Small cardamoms.
4 News, information.
5 Arabian jasmine.
6 Spirituous or vinous liquor.
7 A species of the Supratiṣṭhā metre.
E.
प्री to please, aff. क, and the vowel made short.

m. (-कः)
1 A kind of tree, (Nauclea cadamba.)
2 A plant, commonly

Priyangu.
3

A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)
4 A variegated or spotted deer.
5 A bee.
6 Saffron.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Kind, favourable, affectionate, doing good to, or treating kindly.
2 Suiting, congenial.
E.
प्रिय, and कृ to do, अण् aff.

mfn. (-कृत्)
Kind, friendly, a friend, a benefactor.
E.
प्रिय, and कृत् who does.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Amiable, exciting or attracting regard.
2 Acting kindly or affectionately to.
E.
प्रिय beloved, कृ to make, aff. खच्; also with अण् aff. प्रियकार.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
1 Acceptable, grateful to.
2 Acting kindly to, who or what does so.
n. (-णं)
Gratifying, treating kindly, (the act.)
E.
प्रिय, कृ to do, ल्युट् aff.

(-ङ्गुः)
1 A medicinal plant, and perfume, commonly known by the name Priyangu, and described in some places as a fragrant seed.
2 Panick seed, (Panicum italicum.)
3 Black mustard seed.
4 Long pepper.
5 A peculiar tree: see कटुकी.
E.
प्रिय desired, गम to go, aff. डुन् and मुम् aug.

mfn. (-मः-मा-भं)
Dearest, most beloved.
m. (-मः)
A tree, (Celosia cristata)
E.
प्रिय desirable, तमप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Dearer, more dear.
E.
प्रिय, and तरप् comparative aff.

f. (-ता)
Love, affection.
E.
प्रिय beloved, तस्न् aff.; also with त्व, aff. प्रियत्व n. (-त्वं.)

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Handsome, lovely, good looking.
m. (-नः)
1 A parrot.
2 A tree, (Mimusops kauki.)
E.
प्रिय beloved, and दर्शन appearance.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Eloquent, well spoken, of pleasing speech.
n. (-यः)
Eloquence in language.
E.
प्रिय desired, प्राय abundance.

mfn. (-प्सः-प्सुः-प्सु)
Lamenting the loss or absence of any beloved object, wishing or grieving for it.
E.
प्रिय beloved, and प्रेप्सु desirous.

n. (-णं)
Speaking kindly.
E.
प्रिय, and भाष्ण speaking.

m. (-धुः)
BALARĀMA, the half brother of KṚṢṆA.
E.
प्रिय fond, मधु wine.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Beloved, affectionate.
E.
प्री to please, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being pleased or propitiated.
E.
प्री to please, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Sweet or pleasant speaking.
m. (-दः)
A sort of demigod or Vidyādhara.
E.
प्रिय kind, desired, वद to speak, aff. खश्.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Become dear to, or beloved by.
E.
प्रिय, भू to be, खिष्णुच् aff.

n. (-ता)
Amiability, becoming beloved by.
E.
तल् added to the last.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Become dear to, or beloved by.
E.
प्रिय, and भू to be, खुकञ् aff.

f. (-ता)
Amiability, becoming beloved, the state or condition.
E.
तल् added to the last.

f. (-र्णी)
A creeping plant, (Echites frutescens.)
E.
प्रिय desired, वर्ण class.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Sweet or pleasant spoken, flattering, a flatterer.
E.
प्रिय kind, and वादिन् who speaks.

m. (-खः)
A tree, (Khayar, or Mimosa catechu)
f. (-खी)
A female friend or companion, a confidante.
E.
प्रिय desired, सखि a friend, टच् aff.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Pleasant, and true.
n. (-त्यं)
Eloquent, or pleasing, as well as true, (discourse.)
E.
प्रिय loved, and सत्य true.

m. (-शः)
A tree bearing a fragrant flower, (Michelia champaca.)
E.
प्रिय a friend, and सन्देश intelligence.

mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं)
Announcing good tidings.
E.
प्रिय, and आख्य who says.

m. (-लः)
A tree, commonly Piyal, (Buchanania latifolia, ROXBURGH'S catalogue, but the name is applied to different trees.)
E.
पृ to satisfy, aff. कालन् and the radical vowel changed to रि; also with कन् added प्रियालक
m. (-कः)
and with the vowel protracted, प्रियाल.
m. (-लः)
also as derived from पीय a Sautra root, पीयाल or पियाल, &c.

mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु)
Fond of life.
E.
प्रिय, and असु breath.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
Friendly, affectionate, wishing to please.
E.
प्रिय, and एषिन् seeking.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Well or kindly spoken, pleasingly uttered.
n. (-तं)
Kindly or gentle speech.
E.
प्रिय kind, &c. and उदित said.

(ङ्) प्रीङ् r. 4th cl. (प्रीयते) (ञ्) प्रीञ्^1 r. 9th cl. (प्रीणाति प्रीणीते) and 1st and 10th cls. (प्रियति-ते प्राययति-ते or प्रीणयति)
1 To please, to delight, to satisfy.
2 To be pleased or satisfied.
3 To desire or love.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Old, ancient.
2 Pleased, satisfied.
E.
प्री to please, aff. क्त, form irr.

n. (-नं)
Satisfaction, satisfying, satiety.
E.
प्री to please, aff. ल्युट्.

ind.
Having pleased or propitiated.
E.
प्री to please, क्त्वा aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Pleased, happy, glad.
2 Pleased or satisfied with.
3 Gracious, kind, affectionate.
4 Beloved, dear to.
n. (-तं)
Pleasure, delight.
E.
प्री to please, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्मः)
Pleased, satisfied, content.
E.
प्रीत, and आत्मन् self.

f. (-तिः)
1 Joy, pleasure, happiness.
2 Love, affection, regard.
3 The wife of KĀMA, or

Cupid.
4

The second of the twenty-seven astronomical Yogas.
E.
प्री to please, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Pleasing, agreeable to.
E.
प्रीति, and कर making.

f. (-षाः)
The wife of ANIRUDDHA.
E.
प्रीति the wife of KĀMA, जुष to serve, affs. क and टाप्.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Affectionate, inspiring love or regard.
m. (-दः)
A jester, a buffoon.
E.
प्रीति affection, pleasure, and द who gives.

n. (-नं)
A kind or friendly present.
E.
प्रीति affection, and दान giving.

n. (-यं)
A gift or token of affection.
E.
प्रीति, and दाय a gift.

n. adv. (-कं)
Through favour or kindness.
E.
प्रीति, and पूर्व्वक an antecedent.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Kind, affectionate.
E.
प्रीति, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
1 Content, happy.
2 Kind.
E.
प्रीति, and मनस् the mind.

n. (-चः)
Gracious or kindly speech.
E.
प्रीति, and वचस् speech.

m. (-तुः)
A bird.
